answer: Locks are entered in thread, expire in raven, and vertex lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 172 aliases therefore needs 47 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2127 identities would post 3389 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
